verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe documents a batch mode in which a single job can transcribe up to 10,000 files from an S3 prefix or manifest, so creating an asynchronous transcription job is supported. The pack contains no documentation of a status endpoint, a polling flow, or named job states, which are the core of this story. missing for 10: documented job-status/poll endpoint, enumerated job states (e.g., queued/running/succeeded/failed), result-retrieval flow once complete, hands-on corroboration.
